title: hieracium murorum subsp. atrovirens
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. atrovirens, commonly known as the "Wall Hawkweed", is a plant species native to certain parts of Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal effects. The plant is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antioxidant, and immune system modulation. Bioactive constituents of Hieracium murorum subsp. atrovirens may include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites with potential pharmacological activities.
